model_rules.fixed_cubic: OLS training log-quota intercept with log-diameter coefficient fixed to 3; no strain term
model_rules.pooled_free_power: OLS training log-quota intercept and log-diameter coefficient; no strain term
model_rules.strain_geometric_mean: Mean training log quota separately for each strain
model_rules.strain_temperature_trend: OLS training log quota versus temperature separately for each strain; no validation refit

training_weighting: Each eligible biological-culture row has equal weight within the specified fit; positive diameter and resource required in all fits for a common comparison population
evaluation_weighting: Mean absolute log error and mean squared log error within each strain-temperature cell, then equal weight across observed cells; also report individual rows, per-strain/per-temperature results, and maximum error
missingness: Keep every source culture in membership. Empty, N/A, NA, NaN are missing; nonpositive diameter or quota excluded separately by resource. No imputation or substitution from ratios. All four models score the same resource-specific common eligible rows.
calibration_diagnostics: Training pooled and within-strain demeaned log-quota/log-diameter slopes; leave-one-strain-out descriptive pooled slopes; no confidence intervals or independence claims
forecast_scope: Quota prediction conditional on measured validation diameter, strain, and temperature, not a prediction of diameter itself or of allocation neutrality
freeze_scope: Local retrospective protocol recorded before CSV acquisition; a second coefficient-and-prediction freeze precedes conversion of validation quota fields. Published metadata/methods were already inspected, not external preregistration or guaranteed external blinding.
